{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes AcceptPackage() eviction error reporting in src/validation.cpp from TX_MEMPOOL_POLICY to TX_RECONSIDERABLE.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes mempool package acceptance so immediately trimmed transactions return TX_RECONSIDERABLE instead of TX_MEMPOOL_POLICY. As the PR notes, the existing behavior 'precludes the now-evicted parent from being considered again... until after another block is found,' creating unneeded censorship for packages that are trimmed on entry."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled P2P, touches test/functional/p2p_opportunistic_1p1c.py, and fixes transaction relay handling in peer reject filters.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents evicted package transactions from being placed into peer reject filters where they cannot be reconsidered before the next block. Reviewers emphasize this is relevant for p2p 1p1c package relay, ensuring an evicted parent can be reconsidered when announced with a higher-fee child."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp solely for mempool package acceptance policy logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Excluded from validation because the change specifically governs mempool policy and package acceptance results, which belong to mempool rather than consensus validation."
    }
  ],
